run_replace_oovs: run the script to replace out-of-vocabulary words in source and target sequences with position tokens
run_preprocess_cli: run the CLI tool with --source, --vocab, and --source-out args to preprocess text sequences
run_preprocess_with_target: run the preprocess script with --target and --target-out to also process target sequences
review_replace_oovs: review the replace_oovs function that maps OOV tokens to their source sequence positions
refactor_replace_oovs: refactor the replace_oovs function to support a different OOV token format or vocabulary source
